 Kang Ha-neul to appear as psychiatrist in new medical drama
 Clockwise from top left, actors Kang Ha-neul, Kim Hye-jun, Kim Sun-young and Huh Joon-ho / Courtesy of TH Company, Management MMM, Kang Entertainment, Story J Company
 By Yonhap Published Nov 9, 2026 10:02 AM KST 
 Updated Nov 9, 2026 10:04 AM KST 
 Actor Kang Ha-neul will appear as a psychiatrist in the upcoming medical drama "Mind Doctor," set to premiere in the first half of next year, its broadcaster said Monday.
 In the series, Kang portrays Si-chan, a cold genius surgeon, who transitions into psychiatry after his brother's death, according to MBC.
 It marks the actor's first appearance in a medical drama since his debut.
 The cast also includes Kim Hye-jun, Huh Joon-ho and Kim Sun-young.
